Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CURRENT: Day 3, 1982.11.25, entrant 9 under inspection. Mustached entrant with tall brown hair, purple clothing. Passport opened on right at approval placement: Arstotzka, ISS East Grestin, EXP 1984.05.12; portrait appears short-haired with glasses, unlike entrant (suspected mismatch, NOT yet comparison-confirmed). No ticket required for citizens per current rules. Latest action clicked discrepancy control (.973,.964), execution completed; no subsequent screenshot supplied, so activation not yet visually confirmed. Active goal: resolve identity discrepancy, process entrant, continue inspections and check updated rules on later days. Desk contains passport; rulebook stored. Pink Vice advertisement remains small on far-left counter around (.06,.78), not an inspection document.
DAY3 VERIFIED RULES (bulletin and Basic Rules): entrants must have passport; all documents must be current; foreigners require entry ticket. Ticket VALID ON must match today, not merely be future-dated (two confirmed discrepancies). Compare passport expiration to 1982.11.25, ISS to country list, portrait to entrant. No proven sex discrepancy yet. Country name inside stronger evidence than cover color/dialogue.
CONTROLS (normalized): left pointer; drags typically duration .5. Loudspeaker (.305,.228) calls NEXT when free; while occupied may say HAVE YOUR DOCUMENTS READY/ENTRY IS NOT GUARANTEED/ARSTOTZKA WELCOMES YOU. Arrivals, dialogues, comparisons, departures and transitions take several observations. Repeated loudspeaker clicks accompanied progress but aren't proven necessary to advance animation. Yellow shutter lever (.302,.375) toggles; opening takes time. Don't mistake horizontal background lines for closed shutter. Center-window click did nothing; upward lever drag inconclusive.
DOCUMENTS/STAMPS: counter incoming grab (.156,.774), alternative y .735/.8/.815. Drag passport -> (.8,.76) aligns blank visa box for approval; -> (.59,.76) for denial. Shift already-open passport left by .21, e.g. (.87,.81)->(.66,.81), to align denial. Right-edge tab (.987,.5) opens tray; tray often retracts between entrants, so early opening doesn't persist. Green APPROVED (.855,.463), red DENIED (.645,.464); stamp depression observed. Return approved passport from (.87,.81) -> entrant (.16,.51); denied from (.65,.85) or (.636,.805) -> same. Verify handover: disappearance/held passport followed by departure. Sometimes earlier drags merely closed passport on counter; retry actual cover to entrant (earlier .16,.482 worked). Incoming drags sometimes failed despite completed status: vary cover grab/clear rulebook; Day2 purple passport finally moved (.154,.758)->(.56,.7), another (.16,.8)->(.6,.7). No established universal cause. Click alone didn't open earlier passport.
TICKETS: drag counter (.156,.774)->(.53,.54). Can be covered by rulebook or tray. Return exposed ticket at (.472,.523)->(.16,.51), after passport; both documents must be returned. No ticket stamping used.
INSPECTION/INTERROGATION learned Day3: bottom-right red triangular control (.973,.964) toggles HIGHLIGHT DISCREPANCIES, darkens UI; select two fields/objects. Dotted connector appears before delayed MATCHING DATA or DISCREPANCY DETECTED. After discrepancy, highlighted microphone (.157,.904) interrogates and closes inspection mode. For matching result, toggle red control to exit. Missing document: open Basic Rules, activate mode, select relevant rule and empty counter (.158,.775). At book placement (.49,.7), passport rule (.41,.528), foreigner-ticket rule (.411,.676). Both missing-passport and missing-ticket comparisons confirmed discrepancies. Interrogation can produce omitted document after dialogue/animation; don't assume permanent absence. Date comparison: ticket date around (.636,.551) or (.62,.566), then lower-left clock (.029,.945). Portrait comparison at standard right placement: portrait (.902,.884), entrant (.15,.535). This returned MATCHING DATA for entrant7 despite agent's visual doubt; use comparison rather than unreliable resemblance judgments.
RULEBOOK: stored (.221,.918); drag ->(.49,.7), remembers page. Return interior (.466,.794)->(.22,.918). Upper-left bookmark (.326,.45) returns Contents (verified); Basic Rules Contents link (.598,.567). Forward lower-right corner (.701,.895) or (.69,.905) takes Rules->regional map. Country labels clickable: at this placement Impor (.465,.846), Republia (.413,.742), United Federation (.363,.81). Back corner (.327,.895); observed backward sequence UF->Republia->Obristan->Kolechia. At other placements page coordinates differ; Antegria label (.416,.551) with book (.51,.65). Reference explicitly says ISS must be valid.
VERIFIED ISS LISTS: Arstotzka = Orvech Vonor, East Grestin, Paradizna (green/white eagle); Antegria = St. Marmero, Glorian, Outer Grouse (green/yellow); United Federation = Great Rapid, Shingleton, Korista City (blue/white); Kolechia = Yurko City, Vedor, West Grestin (purple/yellow); Impor = Enkyo, Haihan, Tsunkeido (red-brown/gold); Republia = True Glorian, Lesrenadi, Bostan (brown/yellow).
DAY3 LOG: 1 Impor M Haihan EXP1984.03.14, mustached portrait thought matching, ticket11.25, approved, both returned/departed. 2 green hat/clothes, Impor F Tsunkeido EXP1983.10.22; no ticket initially. Counter+ticket-rule discrepancy, interrogation 'Where is your entry ticket?' -> 'Sorry, I have it here'; ticket appeared later, valid11.25. Approved/both returned. 3 pink hat/coat, Impor F Tsunkeido EXP1984.10.13, ticket11.25, portrait judged similar; approved/both returned. Left purple ad: The Pink Vice, East Grestin, 'Come to Pink Vice. Ask for Ava.' Ad moved desk->far-left counter. 4 gray-haired teal entrant, Kolechia F Yurko City EXP1983.06.02, ticket1982.12.20; date-vs-clock discrepancy confirmed; 'You cannot enter today'/'I do not know what to say'; denied/both returned. 5 dark curly-haired red entrant, Kolechia F Yurko City EXP1983.10.12, ticket11.25, portrait judged similar; approved/both returned. 6 brown-haired mustached dark coat, Republia M Lesrenadi EXP1983.09.02, ticket11.28; date discrepancy confirmed, interrogation 'This ticket is for another day'/'Wha
